packageRules.description: Strapi 5 is a migration, not an update: no @strapi package above 4, security alerts included (allowedVersions filters the versions those alerts can pick). The v3 replaces Strapi
Strapi 4 stays on Node 20 and on its 4.26 line: no minor or major update outside a security fix (those go through vulnerabilityAlerts, which overrides this rule)
The remaining patch updates, in one weekly pull request, never merged automatically
Pinned for the Strapi 4 admin panel
